voicing: ElevenLabs eleven_v4 via fal; each speaker's lines voiced as connected passages with per-line audio tags; lines cut with Scribe word times (breaths and laughs before a line kept); no time-stretch (speed 1 on every line)
gaps: word end → next first word: l02 0.5 s, l03 0.62 s, l04 0.18 s, l05 0.12 s, l06 1.2 s, l07 native, l08 native, l09 0.8 s, l10 native, l11 native, l12 0.75 s, l13 native, l14 native, l15 0.8 s, l16 native, l17 0.7 s, l18 native, l19 native, l20 0.8 s, l21 0.32 s, l22 0.5 s; native = the passage's own pause
room: small-room reverb (RT60 0.35 s IR, wet -17 dB), laptop-mic EQ + gentle compressor, room tone at -56 dBFS RMS through the whole file
both: l22 = Wei + Jess mixed, each at -19 LUFS before the master, Jess 60 ms later
startEnd: startMs/endMs = the line's audio span in voice-full (incl. its breath/laugh; same-speaker joins split at the pause midpoint); speechStartMs/speechEndMs = first word start / last word end (Scribe on the take)

lines.speaker: wei
lines.text: Hi, I'm Wei.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: I'm Jess, and we built ChillaHub.

lines.speaker: wei
lines.text: We help small sellers reach shoppers in other countries.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Without the late nights.

lines.speaker: wei
lines.text: Well, fewer late nights.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: You upload your product photos and details once.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Then you check and confirm the facts.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: We call that Product Truth.

lines.speaker: wei
lines.text: That's the part we never guess.

lines.speaker: wei
lines.text: From Product Truth, we create images, listings and videos.

lines.speaker: wei
lines.text: Each is made for its market and its platform.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: We check every draft against Product Truth.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: We check the platform rules too.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Nothing goes live until you approve it.

lines.speaker: wei
lines.text: Once it's live, we learn from your store data.

lines.speaker: wei
lines.text: We read customer feedback as well.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: Then we suggest updates.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: You decide what changes.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: We never change your facts on our own.

lines.speaker: wei
lines.text: Make, list, learn, improve.

lines.speaker: jess
lines.text: It all runs on Product Truth.

lines.speaker: both
lines.text: Thanks for watching!
